defect: The text lets U be an arbitrary open subset of X, lets (U_alpha) cover U, and defines B' as the B-elements contained in at least one U_alpha; it then calls B' a basis of the topology of X. In general B' covers only U, so it is a basis for the topology of U, not X.
smallest_proposed_correction: Replace 'de la topologie de X' with 'de la topologie de U'.
translation_impact: No silent correction: rendered Chinese retains 'X 的一个拓扑基'; candidate is sidecar-only.

defect: The morphism is declared from (X,A) to (Y,B), so the sheaf component must run from B to A in the ψ-morphism convention; the printed formula instead uses the unrelated placeholders G->F.
smallest_proposed_correction: Replace theta:G->F with theta:B->A in the derived corrected branch only; preserve the literal canonical line and translate the EGA II erratum at its physical locus.
translation_impact: Canonical Chinese EGA I retains theta:G->F with only the non-rendering comment EGA1-ERR-0002; no visible correction or footnote is added.

defect: Section 4.4.8 introduces u' as the homomorphism from H to G, but immediately defines v''=v∘v' and uses v' on both subsequent arrows. No v' was introduced at this locus, while u' is never used again.
smallest_proposed_correction: Replace u' by v' in the introductory sentence of 4.4.8.
translation_impact: No silent correction: canonical Chinese preserves u' in the introduction and v' in the composite/arrows, with only the non-rendering comment EGA1-ERR-0003.

defect: The proof defines M^{(n)} as the elements whose components y_k vanish for k<n, hence M^{(0)}=M. It then says the classes of z_h modulo M^{(0)} generate grad(M), but those classes are all zero; the degree-zero generating classes belong modulo M^{(1)}.
smallest_proposed_correction: Replace M^{(0)} by M^{(1)} in the sentence about the classes of z_h generating grad(M).
translation_impact: No silent correction: canonical Chinese retains M^{(0)} with only the non-rendering EGA1-ERR-0014 comment; the later printed EGA II erratum about M_n/M_{n-1} will be translated at its own locus.

defect: The separated completion of M is printed as varprojlim_u M/J^nM, but the inverse system is indexed by the positive integer n; u is the name of a later homomorphism in the exact sequence and cannot index this limit.
smallest_proposed_correction: Replace the inverse-limit subscript u by n in widehat M=varprojlim_u M/J^nM.
translation_impact: No silent correction: canonical Chinese retains varprojlim_u with only the non-rendering EGA1-ERR-0015 comment.

defect: The canonical isomorphism display begins with an unmatched opening square delimiter before (A{T_1,...,T_r}){T_{r+1},...,T_s} and has no closing delimiter. The delimiter does not group a mathematical subexpression and is visibly stray in the French print.
smallest_proposed_correction: Delete the lone \\Bigl[ before (A\\{T_1,...,T_r\\})\\{T_{r+1},...,T_s\\}; make no other change to the isomorphism.
translation_impact: No silent correction: canonical Chinese retains the opening delimiter with only the non-rendering EGA1-ERR-0016 comment.

defect: The proof chooses a_j whose classes generate JB/J^2B as a B/JB-module and c_i whose classes generate B/JB as an A/J-algebra, but then claims that the products c_i a_j generate B/J^2B as an A/J^2-algebra. Those products all lie in JB/J^2B, so their images in B/JB are zero and cannot supply the required quotient-algebra generators.
smallest_proposed_correction: Replace the product notation c_i a_j by the comma-separated family c_i, a_j in the generator sentence.
translation_impact: No silent correction: canonical Chinese retains c_i a_j with only the non-rendering EGA1-ERR-0017 comment.

defect: The closing clause grammatically identifies the proposition being proved as (7.2.8). The active proof is Proposition 7.6.11, while 7.2.8 is an earlier corollary that supplies the Noetherian inverse-limit criterion used at this exact final step. The citation is therefore logically relevant but syntactically attached in the wrong role.
smallest_proposed_correction: Replace the closing clause by « ce qui, d'après (7.2.8), achève de démontrer la proposition. » This keeps the required citation while making clear that the proposition being proved is 7.6.11.
translation_impact: No silent correction: canonical Chinese retains the printed attachment to (7.2.8) with only the non-rendering EGA1-ERR-0018 comment.

defect: The universal-property sentence states uniqueness twice in the same existential clause: « et un seul » appears once before w and again immediately before « tel que ». The second occurrence is a duplicated phrase, not a second mathematical condition.
smallest_proposed_correction: Delete the second « et un seul » immediately before « tel que », leaving one uniqueness assertion.
translation_impact: No silent correction: canonical Chinese retains two uniqueness assertions with only the non-rendering EGA1-ERR-0019 comment.

defect: The proof says that every ideal of A is contained in a maximal ideal. The unit ideal A is an ideal but is contained in no maximal ideal; correspondingly V(A) is empty, contradicting the claimed nonempty intersection. The argument only needs proper ideals.
smallest_proposed_correction: Insert the proper-ideal restriction: « Comme tout idéal a != A de A est contenu dans un idéal maximal, ... »
translation_impact: No silent correction: canonical Chinese retains the unrestricted printed statement with only the non-rendering EGA1-ERR-0020 comment.

defect: With varphi:A'->A and varphi':A''->A', both compositions in the printed contravariant-functor identity are reversed and ill-typed under the usual right-to-left composition convention.
smallest_proposed_correction: Replace the identity by ^a(varphi circ varphi') = ^a varphi' circ ^a varphi.
translation_impact: No silent correction: canonical Chinese retains the printed formula with only the non-rendering EGA1-ERR-0021 comment.

defect: Ker(varphi) is an ideal of A', so its vanishing set lies in X'=Spec(A'); the proof incorrectly prints X, refers twice to A, and writes the unprimed nilradical.
smallest_proposed_correction: Apply the published EGA II erratum: X->X', A->A' twice, and mathfrak N->mathfrak N'.
translation_impact: No silent correction: canonical Chinese retains the EGA I print at this locus with a non-rendering EGA1-ERR-0022 comment; the EGA II errata translation will carry the correction explicitly.

defect: The field notation is printed with uppercase K twice, while §1.1.1 defines the residue field as lowercase k(x).
smallest_proposed_correction: Replace K by k in both source and target positions of the field monomorphism.
translation_impact: No silent correction: canonical Chinese retains uppercase K with only the non-rendering EGA1-ERR-0023 comment; the EGA II errata translation will carry the correction explicitly.

section: I.1.4.1 proof of c implies b
defect: The phrase calls \widetilde{N} a module and then makes it the cokernel of an A_f-module homomorphism. Under §1.3 notation, \widetilde{N} is the associated sheaf; the A_f-module cokernel is N, and its associated sheaf is \widetilde{N}.
smallest_proposed_correction: Replace module \widetilde{N} by module N; retain \widetilde{N} only for the associated sheaf.
translation_impact: No silent correction: the canonical Chinese retains the printed/source tilde and adds only the non-rendering EGA1-ERR-0024 comment.

defect: The proof is establishing existence and uniqueness of the generic point of the arbitrary irreducible closed subset Y, but its concluding sentence says the generic point of X.
smallest_proposed_correction: Replace de X by de Y in the final sentence of the proof of I.2.1.5.
translation_impact: No silent correction: the canonical Chinese retains X and adds only the non-rendering EGA1-ERR-0025 comment.

defect: The sentence types X as an S-morphism, although X is the object carrying the structure morphism X->S and must be an S-prescheme.
smallest_proposed_correction: Replace S-morphisme by S-préschéma.
translation_impact: No silent correction: the canonical Chinese retains S-morphism and adds only the non-rendering EGA1-ERR-0026 comment.

defect: The universal-property argument introduces the given S-morphism g:T→X and the unique induced S'-morphism f:T→X_(S'), then says the product definition is applied to f and ψ. The defining pair must be the given morphisms g and ψ; f is the arrow produced from that pair.
smallest_proposed_correction: Replace f by g at EGA I §3.3.8 line 456: aux S-morphismes g et ψ:T→S'.
translation_impact: No silent correction: canonical Chinese retains the printed/source f with a non-rendering EGA1-ERR-0027 comment.

defect: The paragraph assumes f:X→X' and g:Y→Y', but its concluding base-change display gives f_(S') codomain Y_(S'). Base change of f must have codomain X'_(S').
smallest_proposed_correction: Replace Y_(S') by X'_(S') in the concluding display of I.3.3.12.
translation_impact: No silent correction: canonical Chinese retains Y_(S') with a non-rendering EGA1-ERR-0028 comment.

defect: The scheme-morphism direction is reversed. Proposition I.3.3.14 identifies X-sections of the base change with Z-morphisms from X to the affine-line prescheme Z[T], and the following local calculation uses the contravariant ring homomorphism A_alpha[T]→A_alpha, again corresponding to a scheme morphism X→Z[T].
smallest_proposed_correction: Reverse the displayed prose arrow in I.3.3.15 from Z[T]→X to X→Z[T].
translation_impact: No silent correction: canonical Chinese retains Z[T]→X with a non-rendering EGA1-ERR-0029 comment.

defect: The universal property of the tensor product yields a k(s)-algebra homomorphism k(x)⊗_{k(s)}k(y)→k(z), not necessarily a monomorphism. Injectivity is neither guaranteed nor needed for the ensuing morphism of spectra.
smallest_proposed_correction: Replace ‘un k(s)-monomorphisme produit tensoriel’ by ‘un k(s)-homomorphisme produit tensoriel’ at I.3.4.9.
translation_impact: No silent correction: canonical Chinese retains k(s)-单同态 with a non-rendering EGA1-ERR-0030 comment; a derived corrected edition may use k(s)-同态 only with explicit source-error provenance.

defect: The printed sentence says that X=overline{X'} is the smallest closed subprescheme of P containing X. That is tautological and omits the defining containment of X' by its schematic closure.
smallest_proposed_correction: Insert a prime after the second X: qui majore X -> qui majore X'.
translation_impact: No silent correction: canonical Chinese retains the printed 包含 X under a non-rendering EGA1-ERR-0031 comment; a derived corrected edition may use 包含 X' only with explicit source-error provenance.

defect: The source and target of the named sheaf map theta-sharp are reversed. For f=(psi,theta), theta-sharp has type psi^*(O_X) -> O_Y, not O_Y -> psi^*(O_X).
smallest_proposed_correction: Swap the two sheaves: replace ‘de O_Y sur psi^*(O_X)’ by ‘de psi^*(O_X) sur O_Y’.
translation_impact: No silent correction: canonical Chinese retains the printed reversed direction under a non-rendering EGA1-ERR-0032 comment; a derived corrected edition may reverse it only with explicit source-error provenance.

defect: The displayed global-sections homomorphism is induced by the structural-sheaf component theta, not by the underlying continuous map psi; the source prints the wrong Greek component.
smallest_proposed_correction: Replace the single Greek glyph in Gamma(psi) by theta: Gamma(psi) -> Gamma(theta).
translation_impact: No silent correction: canonical Chinese retains Gamma(psi) under a non-rendering EGA1-ERR-0033 comment; a derived corrected edition may use Gamma(theta) only with explicit source-error provenance.

defect: Read literally as direct-image subsets under u:B->B tensor_A C and v:C->B tensor_A C, u(b)+v(c) need not be an ideal and is not generally ker(tau). The kernel is the sum of the extended/generated ideals.
smallest_proposed_correction: Replace u(b)+v(c) by Im(b tensor_A C -> B tensor_A C)+Im(B tensor_A c -> B tensor_A C), or explicitly say the sum of the ideals generated by u(b) and v(c).
translation_impact: No silent correction: canonical Chinese retains the printed formula under a non-rendering EGA1-ERR-0034 comment; a derived corrected edition may use the generated-ideal formula only with explicit source-error provenance.

defect: The two algebra identifiers are reversed. The tensor product A tensor_B (B/K) and ideal extension KA require a map B->A, so A must be a B-algebra; the printed hypothesis B is an A-algebra gives only A->B and does not define the displayed expression in general.
smallest_proposed_correction: Replace the subject B by A and A-algebra by B-algebra, yielding: if A is a B-algebra and K an ideal of B.
translation_impact: No silent correction: canonical Chinese retains 若 B 是一个 A-代数 under a non-rendering EGA1-ERR-0035 comment; a derived corrected edition may use 若 A 是一个 B-代数 with the listed errata provenance.

defect: The internal reference is wrong. I.4.2.4 is the criterion for checking immersions on an open cover; the immediately following I.4.2.5 is the proposition that the composite of two immersions (and of two open or closed immersions) remains an immersion, which is exactly the transitivity invoked here.
smallest_proposed_correction: Replace the reference (4.2.4) by (4.2.5).
translation_impact: No silent correction: canonical Chinese retains 4.2.4 under a non-rendering EGA1-ERR-0036 comment; a derived corrected edition may use 4.2.5 with explicit provenance.

defect: The local proof has two free point variables. To prove that f×_S g is a local immersion/local isomorphism, it must begin with an arbitrary z in X×_S Y and define its image z'=(f×_S g)(z). The printed proof introduces only the projections p,q,p',q' and then immediately refers to z and z'.
smallest_proposed_correction: Before introducing the projections, add: Let z∈X×_S Y and set z'=(f×_S g)(z).
translation_impact: No silent correction: canonical Chinese retains the source's unintroduced z,z' under a non-rendering EGA1-ERR-0037 comment; a derived corrected edition may add the one-clause introduction with explicit provenance.

defect: The internal reference is wrong. I.2.1.7 states that an open subset with the restricted structure sheaf is an induced prescheme. I.2.1.8 defines irreducible, integral and locally integral preschemes and explicitly refers back to I.5.1.4, so it is the only relevant target.
smallest_proposed_correction: Replace the reference (2.1.7) by (2.1.8).
translation_impact: No silent correction: canonical Chinese retains 2.1.7 under a non-rendering EGA1-ERR-0038 comment; a derived corrected edition may use 2.1.8 with explicit provenance.

defect: The displayed local splitting mixes sheaves on different spaces: G|V and O_Y|V are O_V-modules, whereas F|Y is F on all of Y. The first summand must be restricted to the same neighbourhood V.
smallest_proposed_correction: Replace mathscr F|Y by mathscr F|V in the local splitting.
translation_impact: No silent correction: canonical Chinese retains F|Y under a non-rendering EGA1-ERR-0039 comment; a derived corrected edition may use F|V with explicit provenance.

defect: The second structure morphism is unnamed, although the displayed identity and vertical arrow immediately require a morphism g:Y->S. This is a printed omission, not transcription drift.
smallest_proposed_correction: Replace Y->S by g:Y->S.
translation_impact: No silent correction: canonical Chinese retains the unnamed Y->S under non-rendering comment EGA1-ERR-0040; a derived corrected edition may insert g with the listed EGA II erratum provenance.

defect: An injection into a singleton implies that the domain has at most one element, not that it has exactly one element. X(Z)_Y may be empty; for example, there need not exist any Y-morphism Z->X.
smallest_proposed_correction: Replace the claim that X(Z)_Y likewise consists of one element by the claim that X(Z)_Y has at most one element.
translation_impact: No silent correction: canonical Chinese retains 也只有一个元素 under non-rendering comment EGA1-ERR-0041; a derived corrected edition may use 至多有一个元素 with explicit provenance.

defect: The printed proof satisfies the local-ring surjectivity part of the immersion criterion but never establishes that Delta_X(X) is locally closed in X times_S X, so the citation to I.4.2.2 does not complete the proof.
smallest_proposed_correction: Replace the printed proof by the published Err_III,10 affine-local proof: reduce to S=Spec(B), X=Spec(A), and use the surjective multiplication A tensor_B A->A to obtain a closed immersion locally.
translation_impact: No silent correction: canonical Chinese retains the printed insufficient proof under non-rendering comment EGA1-ERR-0042; a derived corrected edition may use the published proof with explicit Err_III,10 provenance.

defect: I.4.2.4 is the open-cover locality criterion; the proof needs the composition/transitivity proposition I.4.2.5 after establishing that Gamma_f and p_2 are immersions.
smallest_proposed_correction: Replace the citation (4.2.4) by (4.2.5).
translation_impact: No silent correction: canonical Chinese retains 4.2.4 under non-rendering comment EGA1-ERR-0043; a derived corrected edition may use 4.2.5 with the published EGA III.2 erratum provenance.

defect: I.5.5.4 concerns a finite closed cover of the source and cannot justify reduction along an affine open cover of Y or the local necessity/sufficiency proof. I.5.5.5 is the immediately preceding target-open-cover locality proposition and is the required result at all three loci.
smallest_proposed_correction: Replace each of the three references to (5.5.4) by (5.5.5).
translation_impact: No silent correction: canonical Chinese retains all three printed 5.5.4 references under non-rendering EGA1-ERR-0044 comments; a derived corrected edition may use 5.5.5 after canon disposition.

defect: Two copies of Spec(K[s]) are glued over D(s). Every prime except (s) lies in D(s) and is identified, while the closed origin (s) remains doubled. The printed (0) is the generic point, lies in D(s), and therefore has a single fibre point.
smallest_proposed_correction: Replace both occurrences of (0) in the fibre conditions by (s).
translation_impact: No silent correction: canonical Chinese retains both printed (0) conditions under non-rendering EGA1-ERR-0045 comment; a derived corrected edition may use (s) after canon disposition.

defect: For U=D(s) union D(t) in Spec(K[s,t]), the overlap is non-affine, so the first condition of I.5.5.6 fails. But the source's own extension argument gives Gamma(U,O)=K[s,t]; under the identity gluing, either canonical restriction image is already the whole ring, so the second generation condition is satisfied.
smallest_proposed_correction: Replace the opening claim 'neither of the two conditions is satisfied' by 'the first condition is not satisfied', and replace the closing claim by 'the first condition is not satisfied, while the second is satisfied'.
translation_impact: No silent correction: canonical Chinese retains both printed neither-condition claims under non-rendering EGA1-ERR-0046 comments; a derived corrected edition may state that only the first condition fails after canon disposition.

defect: The displayed arrows Y --Delta_Y--> Yx_ZY --p_1--> Y are composable and their composite is 1_Y; the conclusion that closedness of the composite forces closedness of Delta_Y is the cancellation conclusion of I.5.4.4. I.5.4.5 instead concerns two maps with a common source and the product map (j,g)_S, so it does not fit this displayed pair.
smallest_proposed_correction: Replace the reference (5.4.5) by (5.4.4).
translation_impact: No silent correction: canonical Chinese retains 5.4.5 under non-rendering EGA1-ERR-0047 comment; a derived corrected edition may cite 5.4.4 after canon disposition.

defect: Let A be the union of the irreducible components of X not containing x. The cited component correspondence gives union(U-components omitting x)=U intersection A, so the defined V is U minus (U intersection A)=U intersection (X minus A), not generally X minus A as printed.
smallest_proposed_correction: Replace the first ambient phrase 'le complémentaire dans X' by 'le complémentaire dans U'; equivalently and more explicitly, write 'l'intersection avec U du complémentaire dans X'.
translation_impact: No silent correction: canonical Chinese retains the printed complement-in-X equality under a non-rendering EGA1-ERR-0048 comment. A derived corrected edition may add the intersection with U after canon disposition.

defect: The empty affine scheme X=Spec(0) is locally Noetherian and connected, and the universal condition that every local ring O_x be integral holds vacuously, but X is not integral because EGA defines integral preschemes as irreducible and reduced and explicitly requires irreducible spaces to be nonempty.
smallest_proposed_correction: After 'X soit connexe', insert 'et non vide'.
translation_impact: No silent correction: canonical Chinese retains the printed omission under a non-rendering EGA1-ERR-0049 comment. A derived corrected edition may state nonempty and connected after canon disposition.

defect: The proof immediately treats every D(g_i) as an affine open subset of W: it chooses h_ik in A(W), invokes the canonical restriction A(W) to A(D(g_i)), and identifies A(D(h_ik)) with A(W)[1/h_ik]. These operations require D(g_i) to be contained in W, but the EGA I print omits that relation.
smallest_proposed_correction: After D(g_i), insert \\subset W.
translation_impact: No silent correction: canonical Chinese remains source-literal and carries only a non-rendering EGA1-ERR-0050 comment. A derived corrected edition may insert D(g_i) subset W after canon disposition.

section: I.6.6.2 definition of locally finite type
defect: The definition quantifies x in X and then requires U to be a neighborhood of x. The only canonically determined point of Y is f(x), and V is an open neighborhood in Y containing f(U). The symbol y is free and undefined at this locus.
smallest_proposed_correction: Replace de y by de f(x).
translation_impact: No silent correction: canonical Chinese retains the undefined y under a non-rendering EGA1-ERR-0051 comment. A derived corrected edition may use f(x) with explicit provenance.

defect: The proof has x in X and y=f(x) in Y. Since W_1(x) is required to satisfy W_1(x) subset W(x) subset U subset Y, it cannot be a neighborhood of x in X. It must be a neighborhood of y=f(x); that condition also makes V(x) intersection f^{-1}(W_1(x)) a neighborhood of x.
smallest_proposed_correction: Replace de x by de y=f(x).
translation_impact: No silent correction: canonical Chinese retains x under a non-rendering EGA1-ERR-0052 comment. A derived corrected edition may use y=f(x) with explicit provenance.

defect: The published EGA II Errata et Addenda expressly classifies the current I.7.3.8 text as erroneous. The original paragraph upgrades a generic-stalk isomorphism to a global equality. The official replacement restricts to integral X and Y and asserts only a canonical homomorphism tau:f^*R(Y)->R(X), whose generic stalk is an isomorphism.
smallest_proposed_correction: No local token edit is adequate: replace all of I.7.3.8 with the exact EGA II Errata et Addenda paragraph at lines 470-506 / printed pages 221-222.
translation_impact: No silent correction: canonical Chinese preserves the EGA I printed paragraph under a non-rendering EGA1-ERR-0053 comment. A derived corrected edition may substitute the published EGA II replacement with explicit provenance.

defect: The printed proof invokes 10.3.4 for the existence and properties of the greatest ideal of definition of the affine adic Noetherian ring A, but that is precisely the result of 10.3.5. The published EGA II Errata et Addenda explicitly corrects the reference.
smallest_proposed_correction: Replace the reference (10.3.4) by (10.3.5).
translation_impact: No silent correction: canonical Chinese retains 10.3.4 under a non-rendering EGA1-ERR-0054 comment. A derived corrected edition may use 10.3.5 with explicit provenance.

defect: I.10.6.3 introduces the topological space as fraktur X and never defines a separate roman X, but condition (b) quantifies x in roman X. The published EGA II Errata et Addenda explicitly changes it to fraktur X.
smallest_proposed_correction: Replace $X$ by $\mathfrak X$ in condition (b).
translation_impact: No silent correction: canonical Chinese retains roman X under a non-rendering EGA1-ERR-0055 comment. A derived corrected edition may use fraktur X with explicit provenance.

defect: The printed expression h∈Γ(Y,O_X) mixes the space Y with the structure sheaf on X and is not defined. Here D(h) must be an open neighbourhood of x in X contained in V⊂X, so h must be a global section of O_X on X.
smallest_proposed_correction: Replace Γ(Y,O_X) with Γ(X,O_X), changing only Y to X.
translation_impact: No silent correction: rendered Chinese retains Γ(Y,O_X) with a nonrendering EGA1-ERR-0056 source comment until an independent canon disposition authorizes the intended Γ(X,O_X) reading.

defect: The definition says A is merely a coherent O_X-module, and the following sentence claims a bijection between coherent O_X-modules and closed subpreschemes. The quotient O_X/A and the closed-subprescheme construction require A to be an ideal sheaf; arbitrary submodules do not define quotient rings.
smallest_proposed_correction: At definition line 3132 replace coherent O_X-module by coherent ideal of O_X; at lines 3136-3138 replace coherent O_X-modules by coherent ideals of O_X, exactly as the published EGA II erratum directs.
translation_impact: Canonical Chinese preserves both printed coherent-module phrases under nonrendering EGA1-ERR-0057 comments; no visible correction or footnote is added.

defect: The gluing construction says to take the defining ideal sheaf A to be zero outside the union of the U_alpha. Since that union covers f(Y), the quotient O_X/A would then equal O_X off the image and have support there, contradicting the intended closed subprescheme with underlying space f(Y).
smallest_proposed_correction: Replace 'taking A zero on the complement of the union of the U_alpha' by 'taking A equal to O_X on that complement.'
translation_impact: Canonical Chinese preserves the printed zero-on-complement rule under a nonrendering EGA1-ERR-0058 comment.

defect: The proof says the support of the ideal sheaf a_alpha^Delta is U_alpha intersect f(Y). The closed locus is instead the support of the quotient (O_X|U_alpha)/a_alpha^Delta; the ideal module itself generally has full support.
smallest_proposed_correction: Replace 'the support of a_alpha^Delta' by 'the support of (O_X|U_alpha)/a_alpha^Delta.'
translation_impact: Canonical Chinese preserves the printed ideal-support statement under a nonrendering EGA1-ERR-0059 comment.

defect: The proof prints f=g∘j, but immediately defines g:Y->Z and j:Z->X. The printed composite is not typeable; f:Y->X must equal j∘g.
smallest_proposed_correction: Replace f=g∘j by f=j∘g.
translation_impact: Canonical Chinese preserves f=g∘j under a nonrendering EGA1-ERR-0060 comment.

defect: After explaining the adjunction between maps g^*f_*F -> q_*p^*F and f_*F -> g_*q_*p^*F, the proof writes u=f_*(rho). These maps live on different spaces and have different source and target; f_*(rho) is the adjoint correspondent of u, not u itself.
smallest_proposed_correction: Replace 'we take u=f_*(rho)' by 'we take u to be the homomorphism corresponding under this adjunction to f_*(rho).'
translation_impact: Canonical Chinese preserves u=f_*(rho) under a nonrendering EGA1-ERR-0061 comment.

section: Table des matières, terminal bibliography row
defect: The terminal contents prints the bibliography start as p.215, but the authority leaf sequence places the unnumbered bibliography leaf immediately after printed p.213 and before the two blank leaves that precede the notation index on printed p.217; this assigns the bibliography leaf to p.214.
smallest_proposed_correction: In the printed contents row, change BIBLIOGRAPHIE ... 215 to BIBLIOGRAPHIE ... 214.
translation_impact: Chinese contents preserves authority reading 215 with a nonrendering source-discrepancy comment; no visible correction is made.
